are
class templates that wrap raw pointers to manage memory automatically
. They are defined in the
<memory>
header and implement the
RAII
(Resource Acquisition Is Initialization) design pattern. When a smart pointer goes out of scope, it automatically destroys the managed object and frees its heap memory, completely removing the need to manually write
delete
.
